fields.title-post: Catering: 20 ChatGPT prompts to optimize your fast-food restaurant
fields.rt-blog-html:
Artificial intelligence is no longer just for tech giants. It’s also making its way into the kitchen (or almost). What if ChatGPT could become your right-hand man to save you time, better manage your fast-food restaurant, and boost your sales?

Yes, it's entirely possible to use this technology to analyze your costs, train your teams, create engaging posts or digitize your operations. And it's all almost free. In this article, discover 20 concrete, easy-to-use prompts for getting the most out of ChatGPT in your restaurant management.

ChatGPT, a key asset for restaurateurs

In a fast-food restaurant, everything moves fast. Very fast. Between preparing orders, managing staff and dealing with unforeseen service issues, there's little time for respite. And that's exactly where ChatGPT comes in: a digital ally, formidably efficient, capable of relieving you of repetitive tasks so that you can save time and optimize your day-to-day choices.

In practical terms, you can :

  • Write your marketing content (posts, menus, ads) in seconds,

  • Analyze your costs or margins with tables and suggested calculations,

  • Create clear internal procedures, useful for training teams,

  • Find ideas for continuous improvement using customized scenarios.

ChatGPT becomes your multi-functional virtual assistant, capable of simplifying your life - provided you get it right. 

Note: According to the France Num Barometer and Afnic’s sector study, 88% of restaurant owners now have a social media account, and 52% report an increase in revenue thanks to their use of the internet—proof that digital technology has become a real driver of growth in the sector. This demonstrates that adopting AI tools like ChatGPT isn’t starting from scratch but is part of a broader trend toward the sector’s digital transformation.

How do you write a good ChatGPT prompt for the restaurant industry?

What is a “prompt”? It’s simply the sentence or instruction you give to ChatGPT. And that’s where it all starts. A good prompt should be clear, precise, and contextual.

For example, you should avoid prompts such as “Write a post for my fast-food restaurant.” It’s better to use more detailed prompts, such as “Write an engaging Instagram post for a fast-food restaurant specializing in gourmet burgers, highlighting a promotion where you get one free dessert with the purchase of two meals.”

The more information you provide, the better ChatGPT understands your context. You can even specify your tone (“friendly,” “professional,” “humorous”), your target audience (“students,” “families”), or your constraints (“fewer than 100 words,” “text for display in a classroom”).

👉 Learn more: AI in the restaurant industry: What changes can we expect by 2025? 

20 ChatGPT prompts for fast-food restaurants

What if a few well-crafted lines could transform the way you run your fast-food restaurant? Discover 20 practical prompts designed to simplify the day-to-day management of your restaurant.

Management and profitability

  1. Calculate the real profitability of each product

"Help me calculate the profitability of my products, taking into account material costs, preparation time, and fixed costs."

  1. Identify hidden costs that eat into your margins

" Lists the typical hidden costs of fast food and suggests concrete steps to reduce them."

  1. Increase the average ticket without raising prices

"Give me X practical strategies for increasing the average check at a fast-food restaurant without changing prices."

  1. Forecast sales over 12 months

"Help me create a simple model to estimate my monthly revenue over a 12-month period, taking into account seasonal variations and peak days."

  1. Building a complete performance dashboard

"Propose a dashboard template to track sales, material costs, and customer satisfaction at a fast-food restaurant."

Marketing and visibility

  1. Creating a social media content calendar for a restaurant

" Create a one-month editorial calendar for a fast-food restaurant targeting students, with three posts per week, using a friendly tone and a touch of humor."

  1. Optimize a fast-food restaurant's Google Business listing

"Give me a comprehensive checklist to improve my Google Business listing and attract more local customers."

  1. Generate ideas for highly engaging posts

"List of 10 Instagram post ideas that drive engagement for a burger restaurant."

  1. Write an eye-catching ad for a new menu

"Write a compelling ad to promote a new limited-edition burger."

  1. Building a local SEO strategy for your restaurant

"Propose a local SEO strategy to get my fast-food restaurant into the top 3 on Google (add your location)."

👉 Learn more: How can you use AI to optimize your menu pricing strategy? 

Operations and management

  1. Quickly train a new team member

"Write a quick training guide for a new fast-food employee that includes health and safety procedures, taking orders, preparing food, managing service during peak hours, and tips for interacting with customers."

  1. Organizing a high-volume lunch service

"Provide me with a detailed organizational plan to streamline service between 12:00 p.m. and 2:00 p.m."

  1. Reducing fast-food turnover

"Offers 5 practical strategies for building team member loyalty and reducing turnover. "

  1. Create an opening and closing checklist

"Create a clear checklist for opening and closing a fast-food restaurant."

  1. Managing product shortages without losing customer satisfaction

"Draft a reassuring message for customers in the event of a temporary shortage of a key ingredient. The goal is to alleviate guests' frustration."

Digitization

  1. Automate order taking with AI tools

"List the AI tools and solutions for automating order taking in fast-food restaurants."

Did you know? As this Roland Berger study points out: “The French restaurant industry remains one of the least digitized sectors, despite customers becoming increasingly connected.” ChatGPT allows you to take a concrete step toward this digitization and meet these new expectations.

  1. Track sales and performance in real time

"Offers a simple way to track sales and margins in real time using connected point-of-sale software."

  1. Create a 100% digital customer journey

"Describe the steps involved in fully digitizing the customer journey at a fast-food restaurant, from ordering to payment."

  1. Reducing waste through data

"Explain how to use sales data to forecast inventory and reduce food waste."

  1. Compare the best digital practices of major chains

" Summarize the most effective digital strategies used by McDonald’s, Burger King, and Five Guys."

The limits and best practices of ChatGPT in catering

What ChatGPT can't do (and shouldn't do)

ChatGPT does not replace your business expertise or management tools. It does not know your real costs, nor your local constraints. Its answers are intended as a basis for reflection, not as decisions to be applied without hindsight.

Avoid entrusting sensitive tasks, such as accounting, HR planning or customer data processing, to an unsupervised person.

Protect your data and stay RGPD compliant

Before copying your sales figures or customer lists into ChatGPT, keep this simple rule in mind: never share personal or confidential data.
You can anonymize the information (“Restaurant A,” “Team Member 1”) to stay within the law.

After reading this, take the time to test a few prompts from this list, adjust them to your reality, and you'll see: AI isn't there to replace you, but to save you time (and peace of mind).
